content.title: Research Guides: Demographics: Age Groups
content.text: There may be some slight variations in the definitions of a specific "generation", but the following list generally reflects the standard years ascribed to each: The Greatest Generation – born 1901-1924. The Silent Generation – born 1925-1945. The Baby Boomer Generation – born 1946-1964. Generation X – born 1965-1980. Millennials – born 1981-1996. Generation Z – born 1997-2012. Gen Alpha – born 2013 – 2025. More information available at the Center for Generational Kinetics. Note: Additional demographic terms have been offered, such as: Echo Boomers, Tweens, Ruppies, Generation Next, Gen Alpha, iGen and many others.
